<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/spend_limit_tiers"}
#docs
When a customer's lifetime paid amount (succeeded payments less succeeded refunds) in `currency` reaches `level_minor`, its customer limits per interval rise to `amounts`. A customer never drops to a lower tier after a refund or a chargeback. Up to 10 per currency.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | ISO 4217. |
| `level_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | Lifetime paid that reaches the tier. |
| `amounts` | `object` | **yes** | Customer limit per interval, minor units. day ≤ week ≤ month ≤ period. |
| `amounts.day` | `integer` | no | Daily. |
| `amounts.week` | `integer` | no | Weekly. |
| `amounts.month` | `integer` | no | Monthly. |
| `amounts.period` | `integer` | no | Per billing period. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `spend_limit_tier`. One of `spend_limit_tier`. |
| `id` | `string` | sltr_… |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `level_minor` | `integer` | Lifetime paid at which the tier is reached. |
| `amounts` | `object` | Customer limit per interval, minor units. day ≤ week ≤ month ≤ period. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the spend limit tier is active. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The limit tier. |
| `409` | A tier with this level already exists. |
| `422` | A rule refused the value. `param` names the field. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/spend_limit_tiers" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "currency": "USD",
    "level_minor": 2900,
    "amounts": {
      "day": 14,
      "week": 1
    }
  }'
```
